title: The House That Makes the Night

planned.paragraphMeaning: Aoi and Ren cross the newly formed paper bridge toward Sayo’s open doorway, leaving Kohaku on the bank.
planned.sceneDescription: At dusk in the hidden mountain valley, Sayo waits in an open doorway across a dark river as layered white washi sheets unfurl from her window and overlap into a narrow firm bridge. Aoi tests its edge with her shoe and begins crossing with Ren; Kohaku remains on the starting bank.

planned.paragraphMeaning: Sayo shows Aoi a lantern depicting her mother drying daikon in the snow, while the paper’s old story begins to fade.
planned.sceneDescription: Inside Sayo’s washi-making home, Sayo holds a small paper lantern for Aoi. Its paper shows a simple picture of a woman hanging daikon radishes to dry in falling snow; the pale edges suggest a fading memory, with other quiet lanterns on the shelf.
